text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган beats Нарита Брайан.
After the
race, she spies Нарита Брайан
looking dissatisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wanting a fun race between the two of
them, she
challenges Нарита Брайан once
more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With that, she decides her next race will
be the
same as Нарита Брайан's—the spring
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
